sources.scope: General blood-test education: test description and result interpretation sections; not individual diagnosis.

scope: General blood-test education only, with the report's applicable laboratory interval. No pediatric, pregnancy-specific, disease-management or assay-specific targets.
overview: Counts circulating white cells involved in immune defense.
high: Infection, inflammation, tissue injury, stress or medication effects are possible associations.
low: Marrow injury, autoimmune disease and some treatments can reduce counts.
caveats: The count alone does not identify a cause. Symptoms, medicines and the differential count provide context.
